Level of Detail System | city-super/Octree-GS | DeepWiki
Apr 25, 2025This document explains the Level of Detail (LOD) system implemented in Octree-GS, which enables efficient rendering of complex 3D scenes by adaptively selecting an appropriate representation detail based on viewing distance. This approach maintains high visual quality while ensuring consistent performance across varying scene scales. 1.
